role: E-book library scalar metadata, category-item notes and reading progress
known_patches: Integer identity schemas; scalar integer selectors for legacy CSV-only declarations
Writable persona id 1 and retained readonly account id 2
Existing sign_in accepts password argument used by packlib, preserving legacy pw alias
Four existing Book reads gain concrete substring filters and full scoped lists
Per-user reads scope by session.name and support explicit book_id/fmt filters
Existing reading-progress/cover templates update their declared data; set_note uses source-required create-or-replace upsert
limitations: add_book creates only a scalar Book row; uploaded file formats, nested authors/tags and duplicate-file detection are not executed.
copy_book_to_library does not copy or move source books between libraries; file/index actions only emit events.
update_annotations does not merge a complete annotation map; no stable full annotation replacement interface is provided.
get_book/get_books_by_ids/get_book_content return scalar Book rows; UUID lookup, CSV batches and actual format/cover content delivery are unsupported.
set_book_cover changes Cover.data only, without Book.has_cover side effects.
No category/note listing or author/tag/link CRUD interfaces exist; tasks must supply category item ids for get_note/set_note.
Legacy encoded which selectors, full-text content search, category joins, OPDS rendering and virtual-library restrictions are unsupported.
